name: Kalinov
description: Epistemic gate for agent memory: four tiers, conflict arbitration, physical GC of expired hypotheses. Works in front of the built-in Markdown memory.

hypothesisTtlSessions.description: Sessions a HYPOTHESIS survives before GC removes it.

strictMode.description: Block memory lines the classifier cannot tier, instead of defaulting them to HYPOTHESIS.

workspaceDir.description: Base for relative memory paths. Defaults to the calling agent's workspace (agents.list[].workspace, agents.defaults.workspace, ~/.openclaw/workspace).

guardUserFile.description: Also gate USER.md (where the stock template files user preferences as active directives): lines without a verified user source are blocked. Works best with hooks.allowConversationAccess.

cloud.description: Optional cloud arbitrator for grey-zone lines. Without apiKey (or KALINOV_API_KEY) Kalinov makes no network requests.

apiKey.description: Kalinov Cloud API key. Prefer the KALINOV_API_KEY environment variable.

timeoutMs.description: Round-trip budget. On timeout or any error the local decision stands.

sendUserTurn.description: Also send the user's prompt for this turn (needs hooks.allowConversationAccess).

uncertainBelow.description: Local confidence below this marks a line as grey-zone.

minRelatedOverlap.description: Minimum word overlap before a constraint is attached to a grey-zone line. 0 sends the closest constraints regardless (best recall); 0.25 sends only lexically related ones (less data leaves the machine, misses paraphrases).
